Theorem
[Two-dimensional Type I and Type II ancient solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0094 1. ch29:29.2\group Compact Ancient Solutions

Let $g(t)$ be a compact ancient Ricci flow on $S^2$.

  1. If $\sup _{S^2\times (-\infty ,-1]}|t|R<\infty $, then $g(t)$ is a round shrinking sphere.

  2. If this supremum is infinite, backward blow-ups at suitable points and times converge to a cigar soliton.
